description: This source file implements the SpeechPipeline actor, which manages a speech recognition pipeline using AVFoundation and Speech frameworks. It handles audio input, transcribes speech, and produces speech segments, including authorization handling and format negotiation.

classes.name: SpeechSegment
classes.description: A data structure representing a segment of recognized speech, including the transcribed text and whether it's final.

classes.name: SpeechPipelineError
classes.description: An error enum representing issues during the speech pipeline process such as authorization denial, format unavailability, or transcriber issues.

classes.name: SpeechPipeline
classes.description: An actor that orchestrates the speech recognition process, managing audio input, transcription, and result streaming.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes a new SpeechPipeline actor instance.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the speech recognition pipeline with specified locale and etiquette options, returning a stream of SpeechSegment instances.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the speech recognition process, canceling tasks and releasing resources.

methods.name: handleBuffer
methods.description: Converts audio buffers to the target format and sends them to the analyzer input stream.

methods.name: requestAuthorizationIfNeeded
methods.description: Checks current authorization status for speech recognition and requests authorization if necessary.
